overview.description: The Leverage Shares 2X Long AEHR Daily ETF (AEHG) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in information technology equity. The fund aims to provide 2x leveraged exposure to the daily price movement of Aehr Test Systems (AEHR) stock, less fees and expenses. Aehr Test Systems is a global provider of test systems for burning in and testing semiconductor devices, specializing in solutions for silicon carbide and gallium nitride applications. AEHG was launched on Jun 23, 2026 and is issued by Leverage Shares.
